responsibility: This file implements GCC's small cross-process file-locking utility around host `fcntl` advisory locks. It opens a designated lock file, acquires blocking or nonblocking write locks or blocking shared read locks when supported, releases locks and closes the descriptor, and reports whether the configured host has working lockfile support. Its role is process synchronization infrastructure for GCC tools and build/runtime helpers rather than compiler IR analysis or code generation.
same_name_distinction: Implements the lock acquisition/release operations using host `fcntl` support and the runtime support check. In this same-name pair, the .h declares the `lockfile` class interface and ownership semantics without the OS-specific locking code.
